newsitem.title: USA: Odwalla issues recall on juices.
newsitem.headline: Odwalla issues recall on juices.

text.p: California-based fresh beverage company Odwalla Inc on Wednesday issued a national product recall of fresh apple juice and all products containing fresh apple juice as an ingredient after health officials received reports of bacteria-related illnesses.
In a brief statement, Odwalla said it was notified by Washington's Environmental Health Services that there have been several confirmed cases of the E.Coli 0157 bacteria in the state of Washington.

"Our first concern is for the health and safety of those affected," said Stephen Williamson, Chief Executive Officer of Odwalla. "We are working in full cooperation with the FDA and the Seattle/King County Department of Public Health."
Officials from the company were not immediately available to comment on the number of units involved in the action.
Earlier, officials said at least 13 children and young adults had been taken ill by the bacteria and that 10 cases had been tied to Odwalla fruit juice.
